slides.texte_overlay:
How Social Media Destroys
Your Perception of Success

"Overnight success."

It took years nobody filmed.
You only saw the last night.

"Quit your job and be free."

Leaving without a plan
isn't freedom. It's pressure.

"Rich by 25 or you failed."

Most men build their best
years after 30. Relax.

"Success looks like cars
and watches."

That's spending.
Success is what you keep.

"Everyone else has it
figured out."

You're comparing your behind
the scenes to their highlights.

"More followers, more value."

Reach isn't respect.
Ask the people who know you.

"Hustle 24/7."

Tired men make bad decisions.
Rest is part of the work.

"Smart people just know things."

No. They learn a little
every single day.
